name: current-machine-health
goal: Prove the recorded primary Mac recovery clears the Hub overload chip on the next sample, with current machine reasons shared by Tracker and Hub.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Installed Tracker reported overloaded solely on 6146 MB swap growth at 10:19:23Z with macOS pressure normal, 62% free, load 5.7 on 18 cores and disk 76.6 GB free. Expect the first normal sample to clear the status.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing machine-status example asserted history alone was enough to overload a machine. Replay the retained baseline, pressure and recovery samples within the same ten-minute window.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen 1fa490a143 browser replay failed on missing pill reason in five viewports on harbor-mbp-2. Frozen Tracker regression e35c69c7c9 failed on swap grew 6146 MB in 10 min and on peer recovery.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Require elevated current pressure for swap growth to count. Render the existing Tracker reason inline in the shared Home pill and wrap it within phone width.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
Check consumers of current machine status and recent resource history
